scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w homeApp -w teamsApp -w combatApp
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -n home,teams,combat "npm run preview -w homeApp" "npm run preview -w teamsApp" "npm run preview -w combatApp"
scripts.start: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -n remotes,host "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run dev:host"
scripts.start:nobuild: concurrently -n remotes,host "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run dev:host"
